description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Basket' class within the 'Microsoft.eShopWeb.ApplicationCore.Entities.BasketAggregate' namespace. It defines the properties and methods for managing a shopping basket, including items, total quantity, and buyer information. The class appears to be part of the core domain model of an e-commerce application.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: Represents a shopping basket with a buyer ID, list of basket items, and methods to manipulate the basket contents.

methods.name: get_BuyerId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the buyer associated with this basket.

methods.name: .ctor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new Basket with the specified buyer ID.

methods.name: get_Items
methods.description: Provides a read-only collection of items in the basket.

methods.name: get_TotalItems
methods.description: Calculates the total quantity of items in the basket.

methods.name: AddItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the basket, or increases quantity if it already exists.

methods.name: RemoveEmptyItems
methods.description: Removes items with zero quantity from the basket.

methods.name: SetNewBuyerId
methods.description: Updates the buyer ID for the basket.
